answer: Witnessed Delay Ledger. Each new agent identity must pass a fixed 90-day cooling period during which a randomly assigned, rotating human steward reviews its interaction log; the steward's approval is the glacier that slowly accumulates trust weight. A single forged identity yields a pearl of verified history that cannot be copied or bought. Violations strip the violet badge permanently, forcing restart. Attacker cost: 90 days of sustained, reviewable activity per identity, making mass fabrication impractical.
